report_title: Reproducibility study of: "Competition of Mechanisms: Tracing How Language Models Handle Facts and Counterfactuals"
original_title: Competition of Mechanisms: Tracing How Language Models Handle Facts and Counterfactuals
verdict_prose: Our reproduced and extended experiments validate the original paper's main claims regarding the location of the competition of mechanisms in GPT-2 (competition emerges predominantly in later layers, driven by attention blocks / specialized attention heads)

report_title: On the Generalizability of "Competition of Mechanisms: Tracing How Language Models Handle Facts and Counterfactuals"
authors: Asen Dotsinski; Udit Thakur; Marko Ivanov; Mohammad Hafeez Khan; Maria Heuss
original_title: Competition of Mechanisms: Tracing How Language Models Handle Facts and Counterfactuals
verdict_prose: successfully reproduces their primary findings (localization, dominance of attention blocks, head specialization) on GPT-2 and Pythia 6.9B; BUT extension to Llama 3.1 8B shows greatly reduced head specialization, and the proposed attention-head ablation is ineffective for underrepresented domains
per_claim: core claims reproduced on GPT-2/Pythia; generalization claims NOT supported on Llama 3.1 8B and out-of-domain prompts

report_title: Reproducibility Study of "Cooperation, Competition, and Maliciousness: LLM-Stakeholders Interactive Negotiation"
authors: Jose L. Garcia; Karolina Hajkova; Maria Marchenko; Carlos Miguel Patiño
original_title: Cooperation, Competition, and Maliciousness: LLM-Stakeholders Interactive Negotiation
verdict_prose: We validate the original findings across open-weight models 1.5B-70B, GPT-4, GPT-4o Mini; but single-agent approaches can achieve comparable results to multi-agent negotiations, challenging assumptions about the necessity of agent communication

report_title: Reproducibility Study of 'SLICE: Stabilized LIME for Consistent Explanations for Image Classification'
authors: Aritra Bandyopadhyay; Chiranjeev Bindra; Roan van Blanken; Arijit Ghosh
cert_field: Certifications: Reproducibility Certification (separate field; no Event Certifications)
original_title: SLICE: Stabilized LIME for Consistent Explanations for Image Classification
verdict_prose: confirm SLICE achieves higher consistency than LIME (stability claim supported); BUT fidelity analysis challenges the claim of superior performance, as LIME often achieves higher Ground Truth Overlap scores

report_title: [RE] GNNBoundary: Finding Boundaries and Going Beyond Them
authors: Jan Henrik Bertrand; Lukas Bierling; Ina Klaric; Aron Wezenberg
original_title: GNNBoundary: Towards Explaining Graph Neural Networks Through the Lens of Decision Boundaries
verdict_prose: claim 1 (adjacency discovery) confirmed; claim 2 (outperforms cross-entropy baseline) confirmed under the limitation of intensive hyperparameter tuning; claim 3 (boundary statistics accuracy) partially accepted - high variance between reported and obtained results disproves reliability/precision

report_title: Revisiting Discover-then-Name Concept Bottleneck Models: A Reproducibility Study
authors: Freek Byrman; Emma Kasteleyn; Bart Kuipers; Daniel Uyterlinde
cert_field: Certifications: Reproducibility Certification (separate field; no Event Certifications)
original_title: Discover-then-Name: Towards Adapting Concept Bottleneck Models without Human-labeled Data (DN-CBM)
verdict_prose: core conceptual ideas are reproducible, but not to the extent presented in the original work; many representations of active neurons misaligned with assigned concepts, indicating lack of faithfulness of DN-CBM explanations

report_title: [Re] Benchmarking LLM Capabilities in Negotiation through Scoreable Games
authors: Jorge Carrasco Pollo; Ioannis Kapetangeorgis; Joshua Rosenthal; John Hua Yao
original_title: LLM-Stakeholders Interactive Negotiation Games / negotiation benchmark based on Scoreable Games (FACT29)
verdict_prose: benchmark is indeed complex, but model comparison is ambiguous, raising questions about its objectivity; limitations in information leakage detection and ablation thoroughness

authors: Meher Changlani; Benjamin Hucko; Ioannis Kechagias; Aswin Krishna Mahadevan
